decodeGetEthernetPortTelemetryCounters function only decodes the response for that one particular command so the caller of that function is expected to know which tag value corresponds to which metric.

?  These paths don't look correct for several reasons.

1. These are metrics, not inventory
2. "network_adapters" is not a known namespace in inventory, it's a type.
3. "Ports" is also not a namespace.
4. "network" is also not a namespace.

As written this is splitting these across N dbus paths, which will be VERY inefficient to query.

I am unable to find documentation on constraints for the inventory object paths, can you point me to it? 

The Metrics object path are documented here - https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/phosphor-dbus-interfaces/+/84847

These documents captures the design for Metrics and it mandates the use of split across N dbus paths for Metrics - 
https://github.com/openbmc/docs/blob/master/designs/bmc-health-monitor.md
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/docs/+/84843
